question: JGCK is related to HEAI in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, MJFN is related to KHDL. To which of the given options is PMIQ related, following the same logic?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d50c0bcfec826493724db2deb353d9c8774ee76c923842e12d2fe852e93db03.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1839e813da776262691f021b180595823e36e5aed80b680c7d5feb7171637a4b.png]
